title: Understanding the Design Matrix
text: The design matrix X is constructed using boolean featurization. Each column represents a different food item, and each row corresponds to a person's lunch on a particular day. A value of $$1$$ indicates the food was eaten, and $$0$$ indicates it was not.

title: Interpreting the Row Sum
text: The sum of the values in a row of the design matrix indicates how many different types of food were consumed by the individual on that day. Each column represents a unique food item.

title: Checking the Row Sum
text: If a person eats Rice, Pizza, and Orange Juice, what is the sum of the row for that day?

title: Applying the Concept
text: For the row corresponding to Ashley on day $$10$$, what is the sum of the row?
